scope: Saved-file identities and arithmetic on stored scalars only; exact Fraction sums/comparisons where used. No method import or execution, projection, CDF/exp, density evaluation, integration or new sampling.
not_independently_recomputed: Transcendental optical masses/alpha and exponential omission charges.
Per-component ordinary projection arrays not retained; saved maximum discrepancies checked, not new projection.
Per-cell Gaussian density extrema and their mathematical enclosure premise.
Camera/sample construction from the carrier; saved geometry/schedule relationships and static unchanged-source contract checked.
limits: Consistency audit, not formal floating-point certification, full-frame qualification, latency comparison or a TOG contribution.

mathematical_review: For positive sum of lower densities, the sign of c_i-R at an extremal ratio requires each coordinate at the corresponding lower/upper endpoint; sorted threshold corners include an optimizer.

For zero sum of nonnegative lower densities, positive-denominator mixtures have exact extrema at the smallest/largest colors with positive upper density. An all-zero upper box is a failure, not implicit vacuum.
The channelwise box optimum is no looser than the old quotient-plus-range enclosure in exact arithmetic and is equivariant to adding a common color offset.
Old color-range clipping already fixes equal-color channels; the documents do not claim that degenerate case as new improvement.
post_result_claim_review.cost_and_scope_review: One deterministic color ordering per channel and prefix/suffix scans must be charged, using a specified stable O(N) construction per cell. Bounds remain independent of ordinary output; priority values may change while the priority rule remains fixed. Original full-field colors still govern omission uncertainty.
post_result_claim_review.next_task_limit: At most one separately reviewed and frozen complete box-extrema qualification, identical fields/sampling/tolerances/resource limits and all other gates; no pilot/retry. Failure closes this density-box reference route on these fields. No invocation here.
not_claimed: True ordinary output error from GL agreement or interval midpoint proximity.
Held-out confirmation, formal floating-point certificate, renderer bottleneck or TOG method novelty.
